description: Fork of exp128 switching qk_v2d to smooth_mode=True. Third attempt: keep attn_scale_init=0.25 but drop canon_temperature 0.1 -> 0.001. With t=0.001, the soft V2D output (a-b)/(t+|a-b|) saturates near ±1 even for tiny |a-b|, so it behaves like hard mode at init but stays differentiable everywhere. Backups: stdout_attn0_25.log (orig t=0.1, attn=0.25), stdout_attn10.log (t=0.1, attn=10). out_v2d (final per-block canonicalization) is smooth_mode=False; its temperature also drops to 0.001 (steeper soft backward but minor for STE).
